final_decision.rationale: Pair-0 evidence chain: (1) blur: gm_ratio=0.0953 + spectral_slope_ratio=1.187 + DT gaussian(medium); motion (anisotropy=1.93) re-tested with corrected global = 29.36 dB and lens = 37.40 dB, both below gaussian; sigma scan 3/4/5 = 37.30/37.73/36.96 dB -> gaussian sev4. (2) global: variance_ratio=0.1008, spread_ratio=0.3076, chroma_ratio=0.4417, mean_shift=-7.5 are mutually inconsistent with any linear contrast_weaken_scale alpha (chroma implies alpha~0.45, variance implies ~0.32); contrast_weaken_stretch (nonlinear, maps each channel mean to 127.5) fits: residual global signals after stripping = var 1.055, spread 1.018, chroma 1.062, mean_shift -0.1, unique_G 101 vs 102; sev scan stretch 3/4/5 = 32.59/36.96/30.90 dB -> stretch sev4. (3) no JPEG: block_boundary=1.0068 (<1.05) and adding jpeg:1 drops PSNR 37.73->35.69 with block_boundary off 223%. (4) no noise: wavelet sigma=1.11<2; peeled §B IMPULSE is the documented extreme_pct FP (structured residual, spatial_corr=0.994). (5) no saturation: chroma_ratio 0.4417 is fully explained by the stretch (adding saturation worsens). Best exact-simulation PSNR=37.73 dB (CI 8/10) -> deterministic steps in 30-40 dB band -> per-step and overall UNCERTAIN (severity micro-adjustment only).

decision.rationale: The only change is the blur subtype: gaussian -> glass at severity 4, with the R0-validated global step (contrast_weaken_stretch:4) retained. Evidence: (a) glass_score threshold-boundary on pairs0-3 and above-gate on pair4; (b) gradient-magnitude ratio after stripping the verified global is 1.02-1.05 for glass:4 versus 1.36-1.56 for gaussian:4 on all 5 support pairs; (c) std match improves from 2-4% low to within 1%; (d) consistent +1.42..+1.80 dB PSNR gain on all 5 pairs with CI 10/10 on pair0 and pair4; (e) seed variance <=0.02 dB; (f) no compression/noise/saturation step is supported by the re-analysed signals. Verdict remains UNCERTAIN per SKILL verdict rules (stochastic glass, PSNR in the 30-40 dB band), but confidence is high (CI 10/10, cross-pair consistency).
